system.description:
Olganyar Inheritance: a business. Very Rare, Rot. No item slots.

You own a small boat selling fine blue cheeses you have spent years perfecting. Unfortunately, your cheese is cursed by a woodland hivemind, to whom you are now intrinsically connected.

On a Boat (Passive): You have a small, covered row boat. You can use this following the normal travel mechanics of Sacadia without having to purchase a boat.

On Cheese (Ceremony): The cheese is extremely popular. You may sell it during a Long Rest for 200gp by taking Earn Money Long Rest action. Each time you do, a random number of people (determined narratively by your GM) eat the cheese. They may be relevant or irrelevant to your game.

Hivemind (Ceremony): By working and inhaling the cheese so much, you have accumulated a connection to the cheese. You may concentrate for 1 minute on someone who has eaten cheese from your cheese boat, and they (unknowingly) make a Wiles Check against your Check DC. If they fail, you can read their surface level thoughts for a few seconds, learning what they are thinking about right now.

Rulebook p.54.

business.note: A random number of people eat the cheese.
